mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ARTICLE_VIEWER V JOIN `USER` U ON U.USER_UID = V.USER_UID AND U.FLAG_DELETED = 'N' WHERE V.ARTICLE_UID = ${articleRef}.ARTICLE_UID AND V.USER_UID = #{viewerUserUid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: /* archiveMapper.selectUserUid */ SELECT USER_UID FROM USER WHERE ARCHIVE_NAME = CONVERT_DASH_TO_SPACE(#{archiveName})
/* archiveMapper.selectCategoryName */ SELECT CATEGORY_NAME FROM `CATEGORY` WHERE CATEGORY_UID = #{currentCategoryUid}

/* archiveMapper.selectArticle */ SELECT RSLT.* , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOG_ARTICLE_VIEW L WHERE L.ARTICLE_UID = RSLT.ARTICLE_UID) AS viewCount FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_UID ORDER BY REGISTRATION_DATE ASC) AS NUM , TITLE AS title , CONTENT AS content , DATE_FORMAT(REGISTRATION_DATE, '%Y. %m. %d') AS registrationDate , FLAG_DELETED AS flagDeleted , FLAG_PRIVATE AS flagPrivate , ARTICLE_UID FROM ARTICLE WHERE REGISTRATION_USER = #{currentArchiveUserUid} AND CATEGORY_UID = #{currentCategoryUid} ) RSLT WHERE RSLT.NUM = #{currentArticleNumber} AND (COALESCE(RSLT.flagPrivate, 'N') = 'N' OR #{currentArchiveUserUid} = #{viewerUserUid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR )
